candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Text is character-perfect including full-width （略）. Missing the marginal line number 25, the dotted underline under 「からといって」, and the annotation number 9 beneath it.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text accurate but uses half-width (略) instead of the full-width parentheses in the image. Also missing line number 25, the dotted underline, and the annotation number 9.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Invents furigana readings in parentheses for nearly every kanji word — none of these are visible in the image (hallucination). Also misreads 「イエス」 as 「イエスト」. Missing line number 25, underline, and the annotation number 9.

rationale: A and B both transcribe the body text accurately and invent nothing, but both omit the line number 25 and the dotted underline with the small '9' annotation under 「からといって」. A edges out B because it preserves the full-width parentheses 「（略）」 matching the original typography. C is clearly worst: it inserts fabricated furigana readings throughout that do not appear in the image (a hallucination problem), and it contains a character error (イエスト for イエス), while sharing the same omissions as the others.
